charity_name.description: the name of the charitable organization (in upper-case letters)

charity_number.description: the registered number of the charitable organization

address__street_line.description: street line of the address of the charitable organization

address__post_town.description: post town of the address of the charitable organization (in upper-case letters)

address__postcode.description: postcode of the address of the charitable organization (in upper-case letters)

report_date.description: the reporting date of the annual document of the charitable organization, as YYYY-MM-DD

income_annually_in_british_pounds.description: the annual income in British Pounds of the charitable organization

spending_annually_in_british_pounds.description: the annual spending in British Pounds of the charitable organization
